correctness.rationale: Jensen/permutation symmetrization gives E|sum eps_j a_j|>= [binom(n,n/2)/2^n] sum|a_j|. Strictness for nonflat rows follows from a balanced sign vector with mean signed sum 0 after averaging permutations but nonzero values under swapping unequal positions. Equality of max over eps with average forces constant convolution of sign-row weights w with f(s)=|sum s_j| on antipodal cube G. For every nonempty even subset S (size 2j), integral Fourier coefficient (2(-1)^(j+1)/pi) integral_0^infty sin(t)^(2j)cos(t)^(n-2j)/t² dt is nonzero because both powers even and integral absolutely convergent. Fourier inversion forces w constant positive across all 2^(n-1) classes; converse uniform reps attains ratio, and compactness proves strict subthreshold. Independently evaluated coefficients/extremizing sums for n=2,4,6, finite only.
